issues.reason: Two kinds of clause routes any verb, 'action or state', to a reified event and Thematic roles keeps a stative transitive's subject as Agent ('the manifest lists two pallets'), so the relative clause 'that included ...' owes an include event with the field as Agent — its absence leaves the clause unrepresented as a predication.

Status predicates: 'An appositive ... has no tense of its own: its typing atom takes the host clause's wrapper — past host → (Past (Member halvard wheelwright))', and tense wraps a Measure the same way, so the four appositive atoms under the past 'included' host need the Past wrapper.

gaps_confirmed: the privative / temporal modifier 'former': the compound rule mandates the genus (Inheritance former_winner winner), which asserts present winner-hood, and nothing lets a modifier cancel or time-shift the head it fuses with
hyphenated attributive measure compounds ('a 144-player field', '13-year-old phenom') — no rule says whether the number becomes a Cardinality / Measure or stays inside the compound symbol
'as well as' as an NP coordinator — the additive rule covers 'also / too / as well' only as a clause-level focus particle
new_gaps: an explicit membership predication ('the field included X') — the group section licenses (PartOf <named member> <group>) while the clause routes to an event, and nothing says whether emitting both double-states one fact or whether the PartOf link should be dropped

the Past wrapper on an appositive competes with the durable reading of a privative descriptor: (Past (Member sorenstam former_winner)) is what the mechanical rule yields, but nothing states how a wrapped privative interacts with its unwrapped genus
repair_summary: Added three include events (one per coordinated object, per the distributive default for coordinated NPs), each with the field as Agent, the person as Theme, and Past. Wrapped the four appositive atoms — sorenstam and juli_inkster former_winner, michelle_wie phenom, and the 13-year-old Measure — in Past per the appositive rule. Left the PartOf member links in place: they are true and separately licensed by the group section's 'link any named members with PartOf'.
notes: The nested group encoding (Member field + GroupOf player + Cardinality 144) and the name / compound handling were correct and are untouched.
